Note (E8, applied 2026-10-21): M3 passes means the build can pass: its stopping distance from the brake line is at most 23 m, so a student who brakes at the right point after the line stops with the whole rover inside the zone. A single attempt is judged by the rule zone start + 2 m <= x <= zone end (Physics Model Specification v2, Mission measurement, regression only).

Note (E24, applied 2026-10-21): the Game design v2 plan to replace the Mission 3 column with stopping distances from 14 m/s and from top speed was never built (Mission 3 superseded 2026-10-17). The column stays the tow-model regression from 15 m/s. For the record, DESIGN section 5: from 14 m/s all 27 builds can stop by the zone end; from each build's own top speed 15 of 27 can.
